notes: every chart: 800 x 600, SVG ssr (chart._ssr false, env.node false, getDom stubbed), animation false; the gallery options fed verbatim.
Math.random is the port's xorshift32 from 2463534242, reset before every chart.
a wheel is zrender's mousewheel with wheelDelta = delta / 120.

cases.note: visualMaps: a continuous one with its defaults in a cell, a piecewise one on a cell's right over a range, a continuous one in a calendar day, and one whose matrix is not there
sliders: one in a cell with its defaults (the 'ph' places mix the cell's size with its grid's rect), one in a cell with written edges, a vertical one in a calendar day
toolboxes: one with its defaults (right, top) in a cell, a vertical one centred over a range, one in a calendar day with a padding
a timeline over a range of cells, with written edges
a timeline in a calendar day with its default box (left 20%, right 20%, bottom 0, height 40)
a thumbnail with its defaults (right 1, bottom 1, 25% x 25%) in a cell, over a graph on the canvas with roam
radars: the default centre and radius in a cell, a percentage centre and a mixed radius over a range, one in a calendar day
single axes: the default box (5% each) in a cell, a written box over a range, one in a calendar day
parallels: a written box over a range of cells, a vertical one in a calendar day
geos: the default box (centred, with the aspect) in a cell, layoutCenter and layoutSize in the cell, a written box over a range, one in a calendar day, and one whose matrix is not there
pies on a cartesian: by coord with a pixel radius, by center read as a coord with a percentage radius (of the canvas), a ring by coord on the second y axis; each one's coord widens the axes
a pie on a category axis: its coord names a category; and one with no coord and its default center (no such category: no centre)
on a geo and a cartesian: a chord with usage 'box' by coord on each, a pie by coord on the geo, a chord with usage 'data' (no point)
map series with usage 'box': its own geo in a cell, layoutCenter and layoutSize in a calendar day, and one with usage 'data' on a matrix (its own geo on the canvas)

series laid out on the canvas whatever they name, with usage 'data' on a matrix: convertToPixel through a treemap, a chord, a gauge and a sunburst answers the matrix's dataToPoint; a tree's own view takes the matrix's place (nothing), and a sankey with its default box usage has none (a sankey with usage 'data' on a matrix throws in its view's render)
a grid in a cell: updateAxisPointer at a point in it, findHover on its bars, convertFromPixel and containPixel through it
a dataZoom on a grid in a cell: an inside one and a slider on the canvas whose 'ph' places follow the cell's grid; a window by action
a graph with usage 'box' and a geo, each in a cell with roam: zoom and pan by action, then a wheel on each, and a wheel outside both
the gallery: twenty grids and ten geos in cells (the map a square per canton)

a visualMap with its defaults sits at its cell's bottom left
a visualMap whose matrix is not there is on the canvas
a slider with written edges is in its cells
a slider's ph right is its cell's width less the grid's right edge (the two frames mixed): it starts at the cell's x plus the grid's
a toolbox with its defaults is at its cell's top right
the timeline is in its cells
a thumbnail fills a quarter of its cells at their bottom right
a radar's default centre is its cell's centre
a single axis' default box is 5% in from its cell
a parallel lays its axes out in its cells
a geo in a cell is in it
a geo whose matrix is not there is on the canvas
a pie by coord on a cartesian sits on the point
the pies' coords widen the axes (the line alone spans 2..6 by 3..5)
a pie's percentage radius is of the canvas
a pie by a category coord sits on its band
a chord with usage box on a geo follows the roam; one with usage data stays on the canvas
a map with usage box lays its geo in its cell
usage data on a matrix answers convertToPixel through the matrix
a tree on its own view and a sankey with its default box usage answer nothing
the pointer in the cell's grid shows its x axis
the pointer outside every grid hides them
findHover finds a bar in the cell
containPixel is in the cell's grid only
the graph in its cell zooms and pans
the geo in its cell zooms
a wheel on the graph zooms it, outside both changes nothing
a wheel on the geo zooms it
a dataZoom window on a grid in a cell moves its pixels
the axis tooltip of a grid in a cell shows at the pointer
the gallery's twenty grids and ten geos are in its cells
